Lina K.: Quick ask for launch slides — can eng/runtime run a small smokepack of benchmarks we can cite? Need numbers + minimal artifacts.
Dev S.: What cohorts and metrics do you want?
Lina K.: Three cohorts: tiny chat (~16 tok), support-assist (~150 tok), doc-load (~800 tok). Metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and a simple cost estimate. Also one sample output per cohort.
Ravi P.: We can do that. Suggest 250 samples/cohort, 25 warmups/worker, variants: baseline fp16 + q8. Will report bootstrap CI (500 resamples).
Lina K.: Perfect. Also need a 1-line reproduction command we can paste in the notes.
Dev S.: I'll include a reproducible curl and a short shell script with seed. Output artifact: CSV + samples.zip + runbook.md.
perf-bot: job queued bench-2321110000-smokepack id b-9942. ETA ~90m.
Lina K.: Timeline works. If q8 shows >15% latency improvement we'll use that in headline with CI callout.
Ravi P.: Noted — we'll call out variance and exclude cold starts from main percentiles but include a cold-start appendix.
perf-bot: bench-2321110000-smokepack started at 2321110095.
Lina K.: Thanks — ping here when artifacts are uploaded.
Dev S.: Uploaded: https://files.redwood/test/bench-2321110000-artifacts.zip (CSV + samples + runbook). Quick note in runbook about measurement noise and seed included.
